question: In July 2023, Aadhav Arjuna was elected as president of the ______ Federation of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aadhav Arjuna** was elected as the president of the **Basketball Federation of India** in July 2023.
 
• The Basketball Federation of India (BFI) is the governing body for basketball in India.
 
• BFI is responsible for the promotion and development of basketball at all levels throughout India.
 
• BFI organizes national championships for both men and women in various age categories.
 
• **Establishment year:** 1950
 
• **HQ:** New Delhi
 
• **President:** Aadhav Arjuna

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
